name: Urbanease
positioning: Land prospecting with the canvassing workflow attached — from the parcel to the owner letter.
description: Urbanease provides French developers, land prospectors and local authorities with a mapping platform combining cadastre, urban planning documents, ownership data and constraints, together with prospecting workflow: parcel qualification, owner contact and canvassing follow-up.
real_estate_use: Finding the parcel is half the job; the other half is a disciplined approach to an owner who was not thinking of selling. Urbanease keeps the qualification and the contact history on the parcel itself, so a prospector returning to a commune two years later knows who was already approached, by whom, and what they said.
features: Cadastral and urban planning mapping with constraints
Parcel qualification and development potential assessment
Canvassing history and follow-up per parcel
Export and reporting for prospecting campaigns

use_cases.job: Run a disciplined land canvassing campaign with history kept on each parcel
Assess planning constraints and potential on a site before acquisition
